claims: NASA currently targets April 1, 2026, as the earliest launch date for the Artemis II crewed mission around the Moon.
The Artemis II mission is a 10-day mission.
The Artemis II mission carries four astronauts.
The Artemis II mission has additional potential launch windows in early April 2026 and on April 30, 2026.
The additional potential launch windows for the Artemis II mission depend on weather and technical preparations at Kennedy Space Center
